messages:
sundial_pm: Hey team — Sundial wants to onboard a contract-clause classifier (13B) trained on contracts + annotated clauses. Requirements: never persist raw contracts, redact signer PII, HSM for signing, EU region hosting. Target go-live in ~3 weeks. Can we scope?

enna_cs: High-level doable. Please share model artifact + tokenizer + a small sanitized eval set. cc @farid_eval for quality checks and @ryan_ops for infra.

sundial_pm: Artifact: https://s3.sundial.com/contract-classifier-13b-v1.tar.gz. Data: ~45k clauses, 12k full contracts. Some samples include signer names and addresses. We'll provide sanitized eval bundle.

farid_eval: Quick Qs: 1) Deterministic outputs required for audits? 2) They mention "explainability tokens" — do they need saliency/highlight exports? 3) Latency/throughput targets?

sundial_pm: Yes deterministic for dispute flows. Need clause-level highlights for explainability (redacted in logs). p95 <= 300ms for 512 tokens, baseline throughput 80 qps. Renewal is tied to false-positive rate and any leakage incidents.

ryan_ops: Ops notes: Private EU + HSM supported. We'll need VPC peering and key provisioning window. 13B int8 on A100 recommended for latency. We can expose a redaction hook before logs persist and sign outputs with HSM. Tokenizer and model spec please.

enna_cs: I'll open compliance ticket and schedule enablement. We should mark renewal risk = watch and escalate to HIGH if FP rate > 2% or any PII leakage.

farid_eval: Eval plan: I'll build a Redwood Optimize harness. Metrics: clause-level precision/recall, FPR on sensitive clauses, explanation overlap score (how much highlight aligns with labeled spans), PII residuals scan. Need 600 labeled eval examples + 200 adversarial PII probes. Propose canary: 1% -> 10% -> 100% with auto-rollback on FP>2% or PII_leak>0.01%.

sundial_pm: Uploading sanitized eval to https://files.sundial.com/safe-eval tonight and adding acceptance criteria doc. Legal wants a live redaction + signed-response demo.

compliance-bot: Ticket CS-9122 created: "Sundial contract-classifier private EU + HSM intake"  assignees: enna_cs, farid_eval, ryan_ops. Provisioning window estimate: 2026-05-10..2026-05-24.

ryan_ops: I'll reserve A100 Dedicated capacity for go-live week and prepare ONNX quantization guide. Also request model spec (input shapes, tokenizer). HSM provisioning timeline ~5 business days after compliance sign-off.

enna_cs: Scheduling enablement call Fri 9am CET. Agenda: intake review, redaction demo, eval acceptance, canary plan, procurement. Invite sent.

sundial_pm: Thanks. One more: legal requires proof that explanation exports do not leak raw PII. Can we demo saliency with redaction applied?

farid_eval: Yes — we'll demo highlights with redaction toggled and include PII residual results from the harness.

enna_cs: Closing loop: I'll update account health and track renewal risk on the dashboard until post-canary.

sundial_pm: Appreciate it — will upload tonight and standby for the call.
